stories.headline: SCR reschedules two express trains due to Cyclone Akvan
stories.title: SCR reschedules two express trains due to Cyclone Akvan
stories.summary: South Central Railway has rescheduled two express trains in view of Cyclone Akvan. The Charlapalli-Shalimar East Coast Express and Secunderabad-Howrah Falaknuma Express will depart later than their scheduled timings on Thursday.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence

opening: South Central Railway has rescheduled two express trains in view of Cyclone Akvan.
